comparison.objective: Lock out an air conditioner using a pull-out disconnect and padlock without disturbing a second disconnect.
comparison.physical_skill: Cover manipulation, keyed block extraction, 180-degree reorientation, reinsertion, latch closure, and padlock placement.
comparison.success_condition: Correct pull-out seated OFF, cover closed and resisting a 20 N check, padlock latched, and AC-2 untouched; reinsertion ON or disturbance of AC-2 zeros the run. Component damage is not separately specified.
comparison.reason: Sequential interlock and lockout manipulation test keyed reorientation and latching, not material separation.
